gen-gf-grandstander-fs-chillax: Grandstander stands tall and bold, its lowercase rising high on short ascenders. Chillax lowers the lowercase to a moderate height and lifts the pen mid-curve, leaving loops unfinished, which lets whole paragraphs drift along casually.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-spline-sans: Lines drawn at a single constant width give Grandstander its bold, expressive look. Spline Sans holds its verticals and horizontals at identical weight with wide gaps at the curve ends, making extended reading feel approachable.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-alumni-sans: Grandstander curves without pinching, every stroke bold and expressive. It excels at loud, round shapes, while Alumni Sans stays modest, with barely-there ascenders and stems just a touch heavier than the connecting strokes.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Alumni Sans SC reads tight, its lowercase towering beside its capitals. Grandstander's pen line holds one width and shouts, while Alumni Sans SC's stems, slightly heavier than its hairlines, keep the text beneath it quiet.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-arsenal-sc: Every Grandstander stroke is traced at the width of one stylus. Arsenal SC's lightly modulated strokes have no harsh thin spots, so pages of text stay clean and contemporary.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-inder: Round, loud and unpinched, Grandstander holds one line width through every curve. The standout quality is Inder's near-uniform case height, a restrained sans-serif counterweight to that heading's exuberant curves.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-krona-one: Hairline-free and loud, Grandstander draws its lowercase a in one constant stroke. Yet Krona One drops to a low lowercase with cast-iron stature and loose spacing, giving extended reading an approachable ease.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-major-mono-displa: Open-curved, single-width and loud: that's Grandstander. Major Mono Display brings tube-like, neon-glass strokes and generous sidebearings, a precise technical texture that gives Grandstander's loud curves something orderly to sit beside.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-menbere: Menbere reads tall and tidy, its lowercase stacked up like rolled cord, which sets a quiet, clean tone for the text. Grandstander's round, unswelling bowls then add bold, expressive energy to the mix.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-mukta-vaani: Level beat, no weight accents: Grandstander stays bold without leaning on thick strokes. And Mukta Vaani's high-waisted lowercase gives whole pages of text a contemporary, easygoing glide from line to line.
